name: metis
description: Run one repository objective through a subagent-first engineering workflow with compiled Task Packets.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate one goal through fresh subagents
interface.longDescription: An explicit opt-in engineering orchestrator. Use $metis for managed goals and $metis:model for interactive project model routing; capability documentation remains internal and loads only after routing. Use /goal $metis to keep Main at goal-level control while fresh subagents perform discovery, research, synthesis, design, planning, Task Packet compilation, parallel implementation, diagnosis, review, verification, and curation.
defaultPrompt: Use /goal $metis "<objective>" to run the complete subagent-first workflow
